title: sequenceDerivedMixed
statement:
Use the coefficient sequence module categories, chosen geometric and scalar comparisons, and bracketing interpretation of [def-trf-quotient-system-coherence-data]. The following component equation holds for the stipulated whole-system derived functors, with exactly the coefficient-field, scheme and invertibility hypotheses displayed in the Lean signature below. No boundedness, normalization, Tor-amplitude or coefficient-flatness assumption is added.

Lean statement:
theorem sequenceDerivedMixed
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) {V W Z : Scheme.{t}}
    [∀ x : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField x)]
    [∀ x : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField x)]
    [∀ x : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField x)] (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (integralComparisonSystemComposition l E h k).hom
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι Z) ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E k)
        (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι h).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι k).hom
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l L h) =
    (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι (h ≫ k)).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι V)
        (integralComparisonSystemComposition l L h k).hom

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution f:P → K of the entire coefficient sequence complex. Its image under DerivedCategory.Q is invertible. Naturality and cancellation of this image reduce equality of the two derived natural transformations to equality at Q(P).

Use sequencePullback_kflatgood, the preservation theorem in the sequence-system interface, to show that the geometric pullback along k of P is K-flat. The normalization clauses of integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback_existsUnique then apply to P along k and h ≫ k, and to the pullback of P along h. The scalar counit at P is invertible by the computation clause of its chosen model.

The exact derived geometric compositor satisfies its normalization equation: compose mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac. Postcompose both routes with the common composite target counit, made from the scalar counit at V and the two exact geometric factorization isomorphisms. It is invertible.

Expand the three scalar normalization equations. Naturality of the scalar comparison along the exact factorization for k, of the exact factorization along the ordinary scalar square for k, and of the scalar counit along the ordinary geometric compositor turns the left route into the localization of the ordinary left pasting after the source counit. Naturality of the geometric compositor along the scalar counit and its normalization turn the right route into the localization of the ordinary right pasting after the same source counit. These are equal by sequenceScalarGeometric_interchange_cochain. Invertibility of ell in the residue fields implies its stalk-unit hypotheses by the local-ring residue criterion.

Cancel the common target counit to obtain equality at Q(P). Naturality along the resolution map gives equality at Q(K); localization natural-transformation extensionality gives the asserted equality on the derived category.
